hint.all_day: If unchecked, the closure will be all-day. When multiple days are selected, the same hours apply to each day.
hint.cancel_reservations: If checked, reservations during the target period will be automatically cancelled.
hint.press_check_preview: Press the "Check Affected Reservations" button to review affected reservations.

message.no_reservations: No reservations found for the target period

dialog.title: Confirm Send
dialog.confirm_message: Send bulk notification with the following details?

error.time_range_required: Please select both start and end times
error.time_range_order: Start time must be before end time

template.staff_sick_subject: [Important] Temporary closure due to staff illness
template.staff_sick_body:
Thank you for your continued patronage.

We regret to inform you that due to staff illness,
we will be closed on __PERIOD__.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused to customers with reservations.

Please contact us to rebook your appointment.
template.maintenance_subject: [Important] Temporary closure due to equipment maintenance
template.maintenance_body:
Thank you for your continued patronage.

We regret to inform you that due to equipment maintenance,
we will be closed on __PERIOD__.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Please contact us to rebook your appointment.
template.emergency_body:
Thank you for your continued patronage.

We regret to inform you that due to weather or an emergency,
we will be closed on __PERIOD__.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused to customers with reservations.

We will contact you again once the situation improves.

guide.title: How to use My Reservations
guide.description: On this page you can see a list of the slots you have booked, along with the current status of each one.

overview.title: What is My Reservations
overview.body: This page lists the slots you have booked. You can tell at a glance whether each one is approved and when it is scheduled.

steps.step1: When you open the page, your reservations load automatically.
steps.step2: Each card shows the bookable item name, date, and start–end time.

status.title: Reading the status
status.body: The colored badge on each reservation card shows the current status of that reservation.

items.item3: Blue "Completed" … The slot has been used.
items.item5: Gray "No-show" … The slot was not used on the reserved day.

empty.title: When no reservations are shown
empty.body: What to do when you have no reservations, or when loading fails.

steps.step1: If "No reservations" is shown, you simply have no reservations yet.
steps.step2: If "Failed to load reservations" is shown, it is a connection error. Please reload the page.

empty.no_available_slots: No available slots on this day

allow_public.label: Allow non-member reservations
allow_public.hint_off: Currently only members (MEMBER or above) can make reservations
allow_public.confirm_enable: Non-members will be able to make reservations. Continue?
allow_public.confirm_disable: Non-members will no longer be able to make reservations. Continue?

approval_mode.label: Approval Mode
approval_mode.hint: AUTO = reservations confirmed immediately / MANUAL = admin must approve manually

cancel_deadline.label: Cancellation Deadline
cancel_deadline.hint: How many hours before the reservation can the user cancel (0 = until start, 8760 = always allowed)

remind.label: Reminder Timing (CSV)
remind.hint: Comma-separated hours before the reservation to send reminders (e.g. 24,1)
remind.error_empty: Please enter at least one value
remind.error_invalid: Enter integers between 0 and 8760 separated by commas

book.not_affiliated_notice: Reservations for this team are for members only
book.not_affiliated_hint: Please join the team or contact the administrator
book.error_public_forbidden: Reservations are only available to team members

approval_mode.label: Approval Mode
approval_mode.hint: Use team setting = inherit default policy / Auto-confirm = instant / Manual = admin approval required

unavailability.help: Register time ranges when reservations cannot be accepted, such as temporary closures or staff days off. Choosing a template auto-fills the time range from business hours (you can adjust it afterward). Before registering, you are warned if existing reservations fall within that range.

staff.label: Reservation target (staff)
staff.hint: Targets without a default staff member cannot be selected.

field.time_range_hint: Leave blank to block the entire day.

template.label: Template
template.no_business_hours: Business hours are not set, so times cannot be auto-filled. Please enter the time range manually.

impact.warning: There are {count} reservations in this time range. You can register after rescheduling or cancelling them.
impact.hint: You cannot register while reservations remain.

error.has_active_reservations: Reservations remain in this time range, so it cannot be registered. Please reschedule or cancel them and try again.

notify_recipients.help: Register email addresses that are notified whenever a reservation is made. You can add addresses that are not app users, such as your shop's main address. The free plan allows up to 3 addresses; a paid plan is required from the 4th (up to 10).
notify_recipients.pii_notice: Registered addresses receive the booker's name, arrival date/time, and menu. Take care when registering addresses that are shared externally.

paid_lock.title: The free plan allows up to {free} addresses
paid_lock.detail: Upgrade to a paid plan to register the 4th and beyond (up to {max}).

notify_recipients.limit_reached: You can register up to {max} addresses. No more can be added.

error.paid_required_detail: The free plan allows up to 3 recipients. Upgrade to a paid plan to register the 4th and beyond.
error.limit_exceeded: You can register up to {limit} recipients.
error.duplicate: This email address is already registered.
error.invalid_email: The email address format is invalid.

grid.title: Availability grid
grid.help: Rows are time slots and columns are reservation targets. Tap a green "Open" cell to book. Grey or hatched cells cannot be booked. Use the "Week" tab to view seven days at once.
